essence: The verse names a stilled-mind dream as the waking-end state.
Knowing the seven delights marks liberation and kaulika identity.
After the bhairavi circle ceases, all letters stand apart.
Within this circle there is no difference; all are regarded as equal to Shiva.
All humans reach oneness in the middle of the shri circle.
